title: Lorwyn Eclipsed Special Guest Cards Revealed - NewsBreak
text:
By Peter Tingson ,
12 hours ago
All the special guest cards present in Lorwyn Eclipsed were recently revealed in the set's debut on the WeeklyMTG show. Like other in-universe Magic: The Gathering sets since The Lost Caverns of Ixalan, Lorwyn Eclipsed also has special guest cards. These special guest cards are a set of reprints from other sets that are given matching flavor and new art.
Lorwyn Eclipsed will have a total of 20 special guest cards, which is double the usual ten special guest cards. Ten of these special guest cards are supposed to represent Lorwyn while the other ten is supposed to represent Shadowmoor. Click on the gallery below to take a look at all of the special guest cards found in Lorwyn Eclipsed.
Wizards of the Coast
View the 20 images of this gallery on the original article Among the special guest cards from Lorwyn Eclipsed, Painter's Servant is the most valuable reprint in terms of monetary value. As of writing, the lowest price for Painter's Servant that's currently listed on the marketplace of TCGPlayer is around $67.72. This card's other reprints since its first release were as a judge promo and in the Kaladesh Inventions promotional set. Painter's Servant is a powerful combo piece and half of an infinite combo involving Grindstone that mills out your opponents.
Aside from Painter's Servant, another notable reprint that is part of the Lorwyn Eclipsed special guests is the Bitterblossom enchantment. This enchantment is a staple in black Faerie decks or black decks that revolve around sacrificing creatures to trigger effects. Although Bitterblossom has seen a handful of reprints since its release in Morningtide, it is still a fairly expensive card.
Overall, I think Wizards of the Coast picked great cards to be part of the Lorwyn Eclipsed special guest list. Some of these cards were originally printed in Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, so it's nice to see them again with great new art. While these cards aren't standard legal, they're legal in Sealed, so they'll be playable if pulled during Lorwyn Eclipse's prerelease.
